case.question: I fish from the pier for salmon. For this week, how good do you expect pier fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Pier ratings for this week:** St. Joseph 1, South Haven 1, Grand Haven 1, Muskegon not rated (I'd provisionally expect about 2, low confidence).
- **Go to South Haven or Grand Haven.** They tie at 1, but South Haven's latest pier report still mentions coho, and its boats are doing well.
- **Expect slow pier fishing.** Use shrimp or spawn fished on the bottom, under a bobber or along the bottom. Spoons and crankbaits were the lures that caught pier fish earlier in the spring.
- **If you want better odds, fish a boat.** Boats were rated good at South Haven and Grand Haven, with spoons, small crankbaits and spikes.

## Why

- The newest pier reports for St. Joseph, South Haven and Grand Haven all rate pier fishing 1 (below average), so none stands out this week.
- Muskegon has no pier-specific report in the last four weeks; its only pier report, from April 16, was rated good, so I can't rate it for this week.
- Boat fishing was rated good at South Haven and Grand Haven in the newest reports, so boats are the better bet right now.
- I'd expect pier bites to stay slow until the water warms and settles, since the pier reports have been slow since early May.

## Evidence

**Recent reports (newest is May 7, six days old)**
- St. Joseph pier, May 7: "Pier fishing has slowed. Coho salmon and a few steelhead were still being caught. Shrimp fished under bobbers caught most of the fish." Rated 1.
- South Haven pier, May 7: "Pier anglers are also still catching some coho salmon." Rated 1. South Haven boats, May 7: "Fishing continues to be pretty good," rated 3, with spoons and small crankbaits from 15 to 80 ft.
- Grand Haven pier, May 7: "Pier fishing remained relatively slow with a few coho salmon being caught... Fish were caught on shrimp and minnows successfully." Rated 1. Grand Haven boats, May 7: Chinook rated 3, in 40 to 75 ft, fish 30 to 40 ft down, with spikes, wigglers, minnows and spoons.
- Muskegon, May 7: "A fair number of Chinook salmon were caught," rated 2, but the report doesn't say whether this was pier or boat. Muskegon's last pier report was April 16 (coho, rated 3, on spawn).

**Past seasons**
- I didn't pull earlier seasons for this comparison, so I have no historical pier pattern to add.

**Conditions now**
- The conditions tool returned a backtest summary for the week before May 13, not live data, so I can't confirm current water or wind.
- That summary shows near-pier satellite water at about 46 to 50 F, rising 0 to 2 F over the last three days at St. Joseph, South Haven and Muskegon, and flat at Grand Haven (satellite values).
- Upwelling-favorable wind hours in the last three days were 15 at St. Joseph, 14 at South Haven, 15 at Grand Haven and 20 at Muskegon.

## Caveats

- The newest report is six days old, and the conditions data is from a backtest, not live. Check the current pier water and wind before you go.
- Pier ratings are all 1, so the difference between ports is small; the choice between South Haven and Grand Haven is a judgment call.
- Muskegon has no recent pier data, so its rating is a guess.
- Water temperatures are satellite values near the pier (about 1 to 2.5 km off), not measured at the pier.

## Sources

- St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven, Muskegon: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3df50cf (May 7)
- Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph, Grand Haven: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3de4822 (April 30)
- Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3dd426e (April 23)
- Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3dc30dc (April 16)
